# Polygon Shapefile Baseline

Canonical baseline polygon stored as an ESRI Shapefile using the same coordinates as the GeoJSON happy-path polygon for cross-format comparison.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Case ID | `polygon_shapefile_baseline` |
| Category | vector |
| Format | Shapefile |
| Geometry type | Polygon |
| CRS | `EPSG:4326` |
| Test tier | unit |
| Size class | tiny |
| Storage class | bundled |
| Redistributable | yes |
| Loader | `geopandas` |
| Status | validated |

## Use this case

```python
import pytest


@pytest.mark.geocase_case("polygon_shapefile_baseline")

    data = geocase_case.load()
```

## What this case checks

Provide a canonical polygon encoded as a Shapefile so format-specific loader behavior can be compared directly against the GeoJSON baseline.
